title: Configuring a four-step persona pipeline in JSON
description: Walk through the model settings, skill directory, and per-step visibility and temperature rules in config.json.

steps.description: The top-level fields configure the OpenAI-compatible endpoint (`llama3.2` on local Ollama), a fixed `seed` (`42`), the `.agents/skills` folder, the initial `task_file`, and extra `context_files` (`decisions.md`).
Step 1 (`interviewer`) runs at a higher temperature (`0.7`) to brainstorm clarifying questions. Its `sees` list grants access only to `"task"`, and it stores its output under `"questions"`.
Step 2 (`author`) drops temperature to `0.4` and attaches the `"system-prompt-author"` skill. It reads `"task"`, `"questions"`, and `"decisions"` and writes the first draft to `"candidate"`.

Step 3 (`redteam`) raises temperature to `0.9` for diverse adversarial attacks. Because `sees` is `["candidate"]`, the red-teamer is isolated from the original task brief, questions, and design decisions.
Step 4 (`reviser`) reloads the `"system-prompt-author"` skill at temperature `0.4`, reads only `"candidate"` and `"attacks"`, and writes the hardened prompt to `"final"`.
